text:
Emma Li: Quick sync — we need a 1-page sales cheat-sheet / decision tree for enterprise leads that surfaces security, SLA tiers, and deploy-mode guidance. Goal: enable AEs to route inbound (self-serve, AE, or SE-led) in the first touch. Can folks pick owners and call out required benchmarks + one clear CTA?

Raj Patel: +1. Keep it scannable: hero line, 3 lanes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), top-level tradeoffs, SLA bullets, required customer signals to route. I can add pricing & SLA language.

Sofia Gonzalez: I’ll draft copy. Need two benchmark numbers to call out for hosted vs. dedicated latency/cost (p95 tokens / $ per 1k tokens). Does eng have the latest perf sheet?

Tom Nguyen: For routing: can we add clear SFDC lead tags and an inbound-play mapping? Suggest rules: small startups -> hosted trial, mid-market w/security reqs -> dedicated eval, regulated orgs -> private. Also need webinar tie-in CTA.

Ava Brooks: I can do a 1-column visual decision tree + compact checklist. Final art size: A4 portrait, export PNG for HubSpot. Any brand constraints?

marketing-bot: Link to previous assets: /assets/marketing/enterprise-brief-examples (internal). Recommend reusing the benchmark bar chart template.

Raj Patel: Draft routing snippet for ops: 
```
if company_revenue < 5M and no_security_controls: route -> hosted-trial
elif requires_sla and expected_qps < 1000: route -> dedicated-eval
elif regulated_data or VPC_required: route -> private-deploy-track
```

Sofia Gonzalez: Copy draft in thread:
- Hero: "Choose the right Redwood deployment for your security and SLA needs"
- TL;DR: Hosted for fast time-to-value; Dedicated for predictable throughput & SLAs; Private for full control & compliance.
- Benchmarks: Hosted p95 gen latency ~120ms (short prompts), Dedicated p95 ~80ms; cost note: dedicated unit economics improve ~30% at sustained commit. (Raj to confirm numbers)

Tom Nguyen: For SFDC: fields to set -> Deployment_Recommended__c, SLA_Tier__c, Compliance_Flag__c. I’ll add picklists and HubSpot form mapping.

Ava Brooks: Layout idea: left column decision tree, right column 3 cards with security/SLA bullets + icon. CTA buttons: "Request Trial", "Book AE", "Request Private Eval". Colors: keep brand + high-contrast for enterprise.

Emma Li: This is great. Owners: Sofia (copy + benchmarks), Raj (pricing & SLA language + confirm perf numbers), Tom (SFDC/HubSpot routing), Ava (visual + export). Deadline: Friday EOD for first pass. I’ll coordinate a 20m review on Monday.

Sofia Gonzalez: Working on language now — will post draft by Thursday noon.

Raj Patel: I’ll ping infra for verified p95/cost numbers today.

Tom Nguyen: I’ll create the SFDC fields and a HubSpot form test by Thursday.

Ava Brooks: Starting comps — will share a quick mock by Thursday afternoon. :art: 

Emma Li: Thanks team — once we have the one-pager we’ll plan a short launch post + a 30-min webinar to drive middle-funnel SQLs. Also, marketing-bot can queue the benchmark narrative for the webinar slide deck.

marketing-bot: Scheduled: draft review reminder on 2345679200.

Tom Nguyen: One more ask — can we include a small checklist for security questions AEs should ask in first call? I’ll add 3 bullets (data residency, encryption at rest, KMS integration).

Sofia Gonzalez: Adding those bullets. Final checklist will be 3 questions + expected answers per lane.

Emma Li: Perfect. Post updates in this thread and drop final PDF to /assets/marketing/enterprise-one-pagers when ready. :thumbsup:
